text:
alex_mc: Heads-up — coordinating today's release train for infra + routing. Plan: Deploy Window B at 18:00 UTC. Who's owning routing, model-serving, console? Need smoke owners + rollback-ready flags. Please reply with: service, smoke-owner, rollback-tested. :calendar:

morgan: I can own model-serving. Smoke check: `./scripts/run-smoke-model.sh` on jumpbox. Rollback plan: revert to tag `v2026-03-17-model-rc` via `infra/deploys/model/rollback.sh`. Tested in staging. ready.

jamie-r: I'll take routing. Smoke: `curl -sf https://routing.redwood.internal/health` (expect 200). Rollback: `infra/deploys/routing/rollback.sh`. Found a DNS TTL edge in staging earlier, patched. ready.

nina: Console team — I'll be smoke owner for console. Smoke steps: open console, create dummy session, save config. Migration involved; rollback is possible but needs coordination with data team. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/console/pull/312. giving myself 30m to finish migration checklist.

sre-bot: @channel Canary policy for Window B: canary_percent=5, canary_duration=15m, alert_threshold=5% errors over 1m. Will auto-escalate to @oncall if threshold exceeded.

deploy-bot: Deploy window reserved at 18:00 UTC for wave B. Update the release slot spreadsheet: https://docs.redwood/release-windows and add owners to the slot.

alex_mc: Great — please drop a single-word 'ready' once you've committed validation steps to the runbook (add smoke commands, expected success criteria). Also ping reviewers for last-minute CRs. Jamie/Morgan — can you confirm rollback scripts are tested in staging?

morgan: rollback script ran 3/3 in staging (clean db reset, reconnect). logs: `s3://redwood-logs/staging/rollback/model/2026-03-17.log`. ready.

jamie-r: routing rollback tested once, TTL fix applied, retested. ready.

nina: Console migration has a dependent prod-data change; need to coordinate with data team — give me 30m. I'll update runbook and mark ready or pull console from wave.

alex_mc: OK noted. If console isn't ready by 17:30 UTC we flip it to post-wave. Everyone else still go for 18:00? :thinking_face:

morgan: still go for model-serving at 18:00.

jamie-r: routing good for 18:00.

nina: will update by 17:28 with final status.

alex_mc: Quick CR ping — @morgan @jamie-r small lint fix blocking routing PR #451, can one of you review? low-risk.

morgan: reviewing now, ETA 10m.

jamie-r: I can merge once lint fixed.

morgan: merged. :tada:﻿

alex_mc: Awesome. Final checklist for wave: 1) smoke commands in runbook, 2) rollback scripts tested + logs attached, 3) reviewers acked, 4) postmortem template prepped (link in runbook). I'll post final go/no-go at 17:45 UTC.

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: alert dry-run at T-10m, monitor baseline at T+5m. Will post to #incidents if thresholds cross.

alex_mc: Thanks everyone — will follow up at 17:45 with final decision. Keep pings short in this thread to avoid noise.
